title: Edgar Mitchell on the Moon landing imagery

tellings.quote: "James, it wouldn't surprise me." me. He goes, "We had hustleblot cameras with no viewfinders, gardening gloves on."

plain: When asked about the Moon landing pictures, the Apollo 14 astronaut Edgar Mitchell said, "James, it wouldn't surprise me," according to the UFO documentary maker James Fox, who says Mitchell told him this in person. Mitchell went on that the astronauts had Hasselblad cameras "with no viewfinders" and wore what amounted to gardening gloves. Fox tells it as a hint that some of the famous images may not have been taken the way the public was told.
